title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products
title.provenance:
HOUSE BILL 465-FN - AS INTRODUCED
AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.

pfas_definition.provenance: (d)  'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.

date.provenance: 2  Effective Date.  This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

who.provenance: II.(a)  A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

action.provenance: II.(a)  A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

value: Aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments
products.provenance: This bill restricts the use of per and polyfluoroalkyl substances in rugs, carpets, and aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments sold in New Hampshire.

value: The sale or resale of used products
exceptions.provenance: II.(b)  This paragraph shall not apply to the sale or resale of used products.

intentionally_added.provenance: (c)  'Intentionally added' means the addition of a chemical in a product that serves an intended function in the product component.
